# Colecto v0.7.0

Right-click menus, stars, search filters and earlier messages of a conversation, one
background service in place of two, and Android updates that install over the last
version.

## What you'll notice

- **A menu on every message.** Right-click a message, or press Shift+F10 or the Menu
  key, to mark it read or unread, star it, label it, archive it, move it or send it to
  the Trash. With AI on, the same menu offers **Summarize**, **Draft a reply with AI**
  and **Check labels again**.
- **Stars.** Star a message from its menu or with the new star in the reader's
  toolbar. Starred messages show a star in the list.
- **Search filters.** Type `from:`, `to:`, `is:starred`, `is:unread`, `is:read`,
  `after:2026-01-31` or `before:2026-03-01` alongside your words, or pick them from
  the new **Filter** menu. Each filter shows as a chip you can remove, and the search
  still runs on your mail server. The search field grows as you type. See
  [Accounts](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.7.0/docs/accounts.md).
- **Earlier messages in a conversation.** The reader shows the saved messages of the
  same conversation above the one you opened, with quoted text folded away.
- **Check AI labels again.** Run your label rules again on one message, or on your
  newest mail from **Settings → AI**. Labels that now match are added and labels that
  no longer match are removed. AI requests also have a timeout you can set (120
  seconds by default). See
  [AI features](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.7.0/docs/ai.md).
- **Settings are where you'd look for them.** List density and date headings moved to
  **Appearance**. Everything about notifications, both what you're told about and how,
  is now in its own **Notifications** section.
- **Text spacing.** **Settings → Appearance** has letter, word, line and paragraph
  spacing. Extra space between letters and lines helps many people with dyslexia read
  more easily.
- **One background service.** The mail service and the notifier are now one systemd
  service. When Colecto uses a remote server, the local service only relays that
  server's notifications. Colecto removes the old notifier service when it starts.
  Desktop notifications now go through the standard desktop notification service,
  which should fix them on KDE Plasma.
- **Android updates install.** APKs are now signed with the same key every release.
  If you have an earlier APK, uninstall it once more; from now on, a new version
  installs over the old one.
- **Fixes.** Sent mail is saved to your Sent folder on IMAP servers that don't do it
  themselves, including folders like `INBOX.Sent`. Gmail accounts with very long
  messages load again. AI settings now see labels as soon as you create them. Hidden
  panes can be shown again from the pane menu. The scrollbar no longer shows through
  Settings, dialogs and the loading screen. Labels on a message stand out from its
  text, and command-runner entries have icons.

## For extension authors

- **[API 2](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.7.0/docs/extensions/api-versions/API-2.md).**
  Extensions on API 1 keep working unchanged.
  - `[[settings]]` tables take `section` (`appearance` or `notifications`) to show a
    setting in that core Settings section instead of on the extension's own page.
  - Context menus on `list` rows (`context_menu`, the `menu` message), `starred` on
    `message_row`, and `thread` on messages.
  - The icons `archive`, `eye`, `filter`, `folder`, `sparkles`, `star` and `tag`, and
    `menu_button` now draws its `icon`.
- **New bus names.** The inbox's `v1/add_row_action` lets your extension add entries
  to every message's menu, and AI's `v1/reclassify` labels messages again. See
  [Bundled bus surfaces](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.7.0/docs/extensions/bundled-bus.md).

## Not yet

- Conversations only include messages saved on this device from your Inbox and Sent.
- The new Android signing and the single background service have not been tried by
  hand on a phone or on KDE Plasma before shipping.
